import trimesh
m = trimesh.load("exports/model.base.87e59dfb.stl")
print("watertight", m.is_watertight, "vol", m.volume)
parts = m.split(only_watertight=False)
for i,p in enumerate(parts):
    print(i, len(p.faces), round(float(p.volume),2), [round(float(v),2) for v in p.bounds[0]], [round(float(v),2) for v in p.bounds[1]])
# tooth centroids for gear2 at y=0.8
g = trimesh.load("exports/model.gear2.c296662c.stl")
import numpy as np
# cross-section at z=2.5
sec = g.section(plane_origin=[0,0,2.5], plane_normal=[0,0,1])
planar,_ = sec.to_2D()
angs=[]
for ent in planar.entities:
    pts = planar.vertices[ent.points]
    c = pts.mean(axis=0)
    angs.append((round(float(np.degrees(np.arctan2(c[1],c[0]))),1), round(float(np.hypot(*c)),2)))
print("gear2 section blobs (angle, radius):", sorted(angs))
